criteria.requirement: Repair _make_seq_field_type caching so CheckedPVector/CheckedPSet same item_type but different item_invariant identity never reuse an incompatible class; same callable identity reuses safely including unhashable callable objects, without equality/hash assumptions on the policy. New generated-type pickle reductions carry the actual pickleable invariant or an explicit None default marker and reconstruct under that exact policy. Lambdas/closures retain standard pickle limitations and must fail clearly rather than substitute another rule. Legacy three-argument payloads lack enough policy information: reject with a clear trusted-model migration instruction; an explicit fourth policy/default marker supports deliberate restoration. Preserve ordinary default-field pickle roundtrips and class names without silently decoding old ambiguous data under a wrong invariant.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
